name: auth-failure
description: A rejected client secret. Entra answers the client-credentials exchange with 401 invalid_client, and the run must END THE TASK IN ERROR: reporting zero assets and exiting 0 is what an empty tenant looks like, so without the error an operator sees a green task and an estate that appears to have emptied itself. The failure comes from oauth2_token() itself, which raises on any non-2xx, so the assertion is the builtin's own message. 401 is outside the transient retry set, which is what the pinned request count carries. No deviceavinfo request may be made without a token, and the secret must not appear in the log.
